== 2008 MPC result and decklist source ==

Added 26th, dropped, in Sunday's consolation from the numbered standings.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation results], Advocate, Players Committee Forums (8 January 2008).</ref>

The 2014 US Nationals Day 1 row now cites [[:File:2014 US Nationals Day 1.pdf]], pages 30–31, which name Brad Eier and show his Light and Dark deck lists. It previously linked the Day 2 PDF. The deck pair, overall event-date range and unknown finish are unchanged; these two sheets do not print a placement or exact event date.

The historical DGMA source names Brad in the Origins Premier Series Top 16. Its printed 1 July 2003 date is an update date.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20050222161122/http://dgma.com/content/default.asp?id=471 Origins Results], DGMA (updated 1 July 2003).</ref>
